name: events-api

dependencies.name: registration-service
dependencies.description: Delegates seat reservation, waitlist, cancellation and promotion; forwards the caller's token.

dependencies.name: events-db
dependencies.description: Stores events, rooms, sessions, proposals and scores.

description: The public API of the product: events, rooms, sessions, proposals, scores, decisions, and the caller-facing registration operations. Owns role-based authorization and persists its data in its own Postgres. Registration state (capacity, waitlist) is never held here; every seat operation goes through the registration service. Does not send notifications or run background jobs.
